preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression:
all(len(lines) == 1 + n for lines in [stdin.strip().split('
') for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with a line containing two integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 2e5), followed by exactly n lines of m integers each.

preconditions.expression:
all(all(1 <= int(num) <= 1e9 for num in line.split()) for line in [stdin.strip().split('
')[1:1+n]])
preconditions.description: Each cell value a_{i,j} is a positive integer (1 ≤ a_{i,j} ≤ 1e9).
Each row has exactly m integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(col) <= m for col in stdout.strip().split()) and len(stdout.strip().split()) == 2)
postconditions.description: If no valid swap exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is two integers (1 ≤ i, j ≤ m) representing the columns to swap.

postconditions.expression: all(any(a[i][k] <= a[i][k+1] for k in range(m-1)) for i in range(n)) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', swapping columns i and j (1-based) in the grid makes every row non-decreasing. Let swapped_grid be the grid after swapping columns i-1 and j-1 (0-based). Then for all rows i, swapped_grid[i][k] ≤ swapped_grid[i][k+1] for all 0 ≤ k < m-1.

postconditions.expression: any((i == j) or (all(a[k][i-1] <= a[k][j-1] if (i-1) < (j-1) else a[k][j-1] <= a[k][i-1] for k in range(n)) and all(a[k][i-1] <= a[k][i+1] if (i-1) < (i+1) else a[k][i+1] <= a[k][i-1] for k in range(n)) and all(a[k][j-1] <= a[k][j+1] if (j-1) < (j+1) else a[k][j+1] <= a[k][j-1] for k in range(n))) for i in range(1, m+1) for j in range(1, m+1)) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else False
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', there exists at least one pair of columns (i, j) such that swapping them makes the grid good. The pair (i, j) must satisfy that for every row, the sequence becomes non-decreasing after the swap.
